front: What is the Web Traffic task?
back: Forecast daily page views of about 145,000 Wikipedia pages for the next 60 days. Metric SMAPE.
mean of 200 × |p − y| / (|y| + |p|). Range 0 to 200. 0 vs 0 counts as 0.

front: Why is predicting a positive value for actual 0 costly?
back: The SMAPE term is always 200, the maximum, whatever the size of the prediction.

front: Strong simple baselines for web traffic?
back: Median of the last N days and a weekday-adjusted median over the last weeks.
A seq2seq GRU network with page and calendar features and long lags, trained on all pages and averaged over models.
Views are skewed and errors are relative. The log reduces the effect of spikes and makes pages comparable.
